text: {"us_status":"partial","label_product":"BALVERSA (erdafitinib) tablets, for oral use","label_version_or_date":"Revised: 10/2025; FDA label 212018s011, Reference ID 5678765","label_section":"Use in Specific Populations, 8.4 Pediatric Use","quote":"In the postmarket setting and in literature reports, cases of slipped capital femoral epiphysis and accelerated linear growth in patients treated with BALVERSA have been reported.","eu":"EU: PRAC Jan 2026 recommended adding growth acceleration/epiphysiolysis; current EMA SmPC section 4.8 includes it for paediatric/off-label use.","uk":"UK MHRA: current UK SmPC section 4.8 includes growth acceleration and epiphysiolysis in paediatric patients; text revision 20/05/2026.","us_regulator":"Yes—FDA pharmacovigilance authors published a public FAERS/literature postmarketing evaluation and state FDA revised the USPI; no Sentinel study found.","sources":["https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?setid=2a8aa5c0-6c92-4566-8c45-e8f4d1fc20ee","https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2025/212018s011lbl.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/prac-recommendation/prac-recommendations-signals-adopted-12-15-january-2026-prac-meeting_en.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/product-information/balversa-epar-product-information_en.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/balversa","https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/100245/smpc","https://products.mhra.gov.uk/","https://www.gov.uk/guidance/find-product-information-about-medicines","https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13008465/"]}
